steps.answer: The wet dog faces us with its tongue hanging out while a little wave curls behind it. The goofy, endearing face is almost the whole picture against that open stretch of water.

The bird looks tiny beside that towering column of seeds. The warm yellow light washes across almost everything, right down to the green rim it grips.
The small round bird has its toes curled around the twig. Its brilliant red face against the green blur is striking, and the motionless puffed-up little body is endearing.

The men are posed shoulder to shoulder with armfuls of animals. All those dangling legs overlap in the middle; the black-and-white treatment and their steady gaze make it feel like a serious portrait.
